title: Uroe Pameran Akhe .
intro: Dikheun keu saboh pameran kekuasaan nyang rayeuk, saboh kelompok peumeu'en nyang carong meurumpok droe geuh geuhadapi saboh keubeunaran nyang hana geuduga nyang akan geu ubah udep awaknyan keu siumu masa.
clues: Kamoe meusyeuhu deungon keurajeuën kamoë, ahli ilusi dan tipu daya.
Kamoe geujak le penguasa untuk meuhadapi sidroe lawan nyang geumat tungkat sederhana.
Watèë kamoë kalon keubeunaran, kamoë rhet bak sujud, kamoë peugah keupercayaan keu Tuhan alam-alam.
Tiran njan djiancam kamoë deungon hukôman njang brat that, tapi kamoë hana meu-ulang-ulang.
Kamoe na kheueh salah sidroe nyang phon that meuiman ubak peusan nyan lheueh kamoe kalon tanda nyang jeulaih nyan.
Geutanjoë ka sjahid sabab iman, tapi geutanjoë akan djeuët keu ureuëng njang phôn that tamong u sjuruga meusajan deungon ureuëng-ureuëng njang djroh.

outcome.label: Hasee

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
